```{r}
# ===============================
# Subset raw_counts.tsv to samples listed in metadata
# (expr columns are exactly GSM IDs, e.g. "GSM3577568")
# ===============================

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

expr_file <- "raw_counts.tsv"
meta_file <- "metadata_GSE125583.csv"

expr <- read_tsv(expr_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
meta <- read.csv(meta_file, check.names = FALSE)

# ---- 0) Detect gene id column name ----
gene_col <- intersect(c("GeneID", "ID_REF"), colnames(expr))
if (length(gene_col) == 0) stop("Couldn't find gene id column. Expected 'GeneID' or 'ID_REF'.")
gene_col <- gene_col[1]

# ---- 1) GSMs to keep ----
meta$geo_accession <- as.character(meta$geo_accession)
keep_gsm <- unique(meta$geo_accession)
keep_gsm <- keep_gsm[!is.na(keep_gsm) & keep_gsm != ""]

# ---- 2) Expression sample columns ----
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(expr), gene_col)

# exact matches
keep_cols <- intersect(keep_gsm, sample_cols)

# ---- 3) QC: missing GSMs ----
missing_gsm <- setdiff(keep_gsm, keep_cols)
if (length(missing_gsm) > 0) {
  cat("These GSMs are in metadata but not found in expression columns:\n")
  print(missing_gsm)
  stop("Fix sample naming mismatch before subsetting.")
}

# ---- 4) Order columns to match metadata order ----
keep_cols <- keep_gsm[match(keep_gsm, keep_cols)]  # preserves metadata order

# ---- 5) Subset expression matrix ----
expr_200 <- expr %>% select(all_of(c(gene_col, keep_cols)))

# ---- 6) Subset/reorder metadata to match expression column order ----
meta_200 <- meta[match(keep_cols, meta$geo_accession), , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(meta_200$geo_accession == keep_cols))

# ---- 7) Save outputs ----
write.csv(expr_200, "raw_counts_200samples.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(meta_200, "metadata_200samples.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Done!\nSaved:\n - raw_counts_200samples.csv\n - metadata_200samples.csv\n")
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(expr_200), "genes x", ncol(expr_200)-1, "samples\n")
